images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a NEW all-angle, full-body anime character turnaround sheet for the original science-fiction novel 断星纪.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED ANIME CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE. Preserve exactly this character's anime identity, facial design, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit silhouette and layers, colors, weapon construction and equipment placement. Replace the dramatic scenery with a neutral studio sheet. Do not reproduce the previous composition.
Primary request: show the same character from SIX different directions to make the whole three-dimensional form understandable. All six figures are the SAME character in the same outfit and the same early-war state, not six different designs.
Style/medium: polished anime cel-shaded character design, with crisp contour linework, stylized anime facial features and clean block shadows. The angled views must give a convincing sense of volume and thickness as a stylized toon character. Preserve the clearly ANIME look of the reference, not live-action likeness. Smooth, drawn anime skin, graphic hair locks, simplified designed surfaces. No human photographic face, pores, photorealism, realistic actor, gritty photo textures or western realistic game character. Adult anime proportions, not chibi.
Composition/framing: large, high-resolution LANDSCAPE sheet, preferred 3072×2048, 3:2 aspect ratio. Neat 3-column by 2-row layout, generous separation, every view full-body from hair top to boot soles, same scale, consistent neutral standing pose, each entire sword visible, no overlaps or cropped limbs. Leave a narrow header band and one small label under each figure.
Exact view order: top left FRONT, top center CHARACTER'S LEFT PROFILE (90 degrees), top right BACK (180 degrees); bottom left CHARACTER'S RIGHT PROFILE (270 degrees), bottom center FRONT THREE-QUARTER (45 degrees), bottom right REAR THREE-QUARTER (135 degrees). Both profile views must be truly opposite sides, and rear three-quarter must visibly show the back. Rotate the model around its vertical axis; don't simply mirror an image. Keep equipment on the same anatomical side in every view.
Face and body consistency: facial proportions, hair shape, coat length, armor dimensions, seam locations, pouches, straps, colors and blade proportions match across all six views. A profile naturally reveals blade thickness; never redesign the weapon to make it wider. Use the reference's actual asymmetries consistently.
Back construction: fill unseen back areas only by continuing the same garment cut, armor plates, straps and seams in a minimal plausible way. No new cape, backpack, thrusters, giant ornaments, spare sword, wings or additional gear.
Background/lighting: pale neutral gray studio background, restrained soft contact shadows under boots, consistent clear lighting, no city scene, no combat, no floating UI or large ability effects hiding the outfit.
Text: one elegant small Chinese character-name header as specified below. Exact six panel labels in order: “正面”, “左侧”, “背面”, “右侧”, “前45°”, “后45°”. Clean typography. No other text, logo or watermark.
Constraints: each panel contains exactly one full character and exactly one copy of that character's main sword; all body anatomy and hands complete. Maintain intact arms and unbroken weapons from the early-war reference.
Text header (verbatim): “凌烬｜断星”.
Character invariants: male about 25; tall lean athletic adult anime swordsman, angular slim face, short tousled black hair, dark attentive eyes, quiet vigilant expression. Simple black/dark charcoal mobile field coat, fitted dark combat clothes, light knee guards, dark lace-up field boots; reference coat silhouette and practical belt/strap placement preserved.
Weapon invariants: the single slim BLACK straight long sword 烬锋·照夜, plain precision-machined hilt with compact energy fittings, very fine pale edge line, no excessive glow or ornament. Keep it in his anatomical RIGHT hand, naturally lowered beside the right thigh at a modest downward angle, away from the body; rotate that same sword and hand position with the figure in each view. Do not transfer it to his left hand in the opposite profile. Small healed lines on the uncovered right hand, no dramatic new scars.
Emphasis: agile silhouette and clean understated equipment; let the back view show the natural cut of the long dark coat and existing straps only.
